text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"24-Hour Forest Observation Channel"... I 
had no idea video streams like this 
existed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Though limited by being a fixed camera, 
I'm grateful to be able to check on the 
forest at any time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The singing of the slanted-eyebrow bird, 
the whisper of the night breeze... I can 
feel it all, even through the screen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, as dawn approaches, it's become 
easier to see the trees in the forest."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. In other words, morning has 
arrived..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having fallen completely in love with the 
streaming channel, Yamanin Zephyr ended up 
staying up late.
